patch_description:
This replaces repeated dense matrix-cube scoring with an incremental bitset-based search. Each graph is represented by 49-bit neighborhood masks, so testing whether an insertion creates a C4 only requires checking whether any edge joins the two endpoint neighborhoods.

The algorithm builds several genuinely input-derived C4-free scaffolds using randomized source-edge priorities, then performs balanced greedy completion. Candidate insertions are chosen from all legal pairs using a degree-balancing score, with mild preference for edges present in the supplied input. A small elite archive is improved through high-pressure edge ejection moves: edges around overloaded vertices are removed, temporarily banned, and the graph is greedily refilled into a potentially denser basin. Every insertion is locally C4-safe, and final matrix validation is retained defensively.
